Stated Claim / Post Context:
Riley Green's acoustic version of 'Bartender in Destin' goes viral on YouTube with fans loving it

Riley Green's acoustic version of "Bartender in Destin" is going viral on YouTube, with fans flooding the comments to praise the stripped-back take.

Actual Article Body:
Carly Pearce called Riley Green "a great storyteller," and said he was  "the only person" for the song, "If I Don't Leave I'm Gonna Stay."

Riley Green continues to drop viral moments online.

The "Jesus Saves" singer has become one of the most famous men in all of country music, and he's responsible for several major hits.

His music covers a wide chunk of the genre's spectrum. It's great for a college football Saturday with your buddies, and he can also give people an emotional gut check.

RILEY GREEN DROPS ACOUSTIC TIKTOK PERFORMANCE OF 'BARTENDER IN DESTIN' AND FANS CAN'T GET ENOUGH

Now, he's going viral on YouTube.

Riley Green and Megan Moroney perform together on Nov. 14, 2024. (Derek White/Getty Images for Audacy)

Green dropped an acoustic version of his hit song "Bartender in Destin" last week on YouTube, and it's exactly what fans have come to love from the talented country music artist.

Riley Green previewed his upcoming song "Lookout Mountain." ((Photo by Michael Le Brecht/The Walt Disney Company via Getty Images))

It's one of Green's most popular songs, and has a low-stakes fun vibe. The acoustic version takes things to a new level.

Give it a listen below, and let me know your thoughts at David.Hookstead@outkick.com.

As always, people were quick to pop off in the comments with plenty of reactions. One viewer wrote, "Love the song."

Another added, "Love this one Riley 🎸❤️✨."

RILEY GREEN REVEALS HOW HE BUILDS HIS CONCERT SETLIST WITH FANS ALWAYS AS THE TOP PRIORITY

A third commented, "These stripped back acoustic versions are country at its finest."

SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER

There's no doubt that Riley Green's acoustic performances are incredibly popular.

Riley Green performs onstage during the 2024 BMI Country Awards at BMI on November 19, 2024 in Nashville, Tennessee. ((Photo by Erika Goldring/Getty Images for BMI))
